dct_title_s: Grenada, particulars of four valuable Estates : known as the Pearls & Boulogne Estates, both situate in the Parish of St. Andrew : the Madeys Estate, situate in the Parish of St. Patrick : and the Bocage Estate, situate in the Parish of St. Mark, in the Island of Grenada, containing together 1808 acres, or thereabouts : which will be sold by auction by Messrs. Leifchild and Cheffins, before James Fleming, Esquire, Q.C., and Reginald John Cust, Esquire, Commissioners for Sale of Incumbered Estates in the West Indies, at the Sale Room of the Commissioners
